ALREADY RECORDED as a gap at event/battleworn_dummy (Setting1) and event/endless_conveyor (SUSPICIOUS_CONDIMENT) -- named here so the mechanism has an id, because it is NOT EV-3: EV-3 is 'the sim uses the shared run rng where C# uses the per-event base.Rng', and the stream C# uses here is the per-player PlayerRng.Rewards, which the sim already exposes as run.rewards_rng (run.py:270-274). endless_conveyor's guard labels its own instance '(EV-3)'; that label is imprecise and should be narrowed. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes_c.py potionroll`): the sim's reward pool is 48 potion classes split 16 common / 16 uncommon / 16 rare, so a uniform choice gives P(rare) = 0.3333 where the game's PotionFactory tier gives 0.10 (and 0.25 / 0.65 for uncommon / common). Three observables at every site: the wrong stream, the wrong population (in_reward_pool is not the character-pool + SharedPotionPool union the source composes), and no rarity tier. LIVE for parity and, because the rarity tier is a distribution change, for the RL path too.
